sha256:53ed87fadf8cca869da921627e6a13c84.summary: A rectangular block-like part with a central front-to-back slot, forming two outer vertical faces and one recessed inner vertical back face. Each of these three visible vertical faces carries a vertical column of three circular holes. The outer-face holes are cyan at the top and bottom and dark blue in the middle; the recessed inner-face holes are magenta at the top and bottom and dark blue in the middle. No back, bottom, or hidden-side geometry is directly visible.

visible_evidence.description: Three circular holes in a vertical line on the left outer vertical face: top cyan, middle dark blue, bottom cyan.
visible_evidence.confidence_basis: Clear circular edges, distinct colors, and consistent vertical spacing visible on the unobstructed left face.

visible_evidence.description: Three circular holes in a vertical line on the right outer vertical face: top cyan, middle dark blue, bottom cyan.
visible_evidence.confidence_basis: Clear circular edges and matching vertical arrangement visible on the unobstructed right face.

visible_evidence.description: Three circular holes in a vertical line on the recessed inner vertical back face of the slot: top magenta, middle dark blue, bottom magenta.
visible_evidence.confidence_basis: Recessed back wall is visible through the slot, showing three clearly bounded circular holes aligned vertically.

uncertain.description: Presence and count of any holes or features on the non-visible back face, bottom face, or hidden side walls.
uncertain.reason: Occlusion: these surfaces are outside the visible field of view or hidden behind the part.

uncertain.description: Exact depth of the central slot and whether the visible holes are through-holes or blind holes.
uncertain.reason: The image is a single shaded projection without depth cues or cross-section; only the entrance edges are visible.

uncertain.description: Whether the three columns are perfectly co-planar in depth or whether the inner column is offset forward/backward relative to the outer columns.
uncertain.reason: Perspective and lack of dimensional references make precise relative depth uncertain.

inferred.description: The three visible columns of holes appear to be horizontally aligned by row (top, middle, bottom) across the left outer, inner back, and right outer faces.
inferred.basis: The holes in each column occupy similar vertical positions in the image, suggesting a regular grid pattern on parallel vertical planes.
